description: This file defines the ScriptHelper interface used within the OFBiz framework's scripting environment. It provides methods for interacting with entities, services, and script execution control, serving as a bridge between scripts and the underlying service and data layers.

classes.name: ScriptHelper
classes.description: An interface that provides methods for script interaction with data, services, and system status.

methods.name: createServiceMap
methods.description: Extracts service input parameters from a map and returns a new map with them.

methods.name: error
methods.description: Sets the event or service status to error.

methods.name: evalString
methods.description: Evaluates a string expression and returns the result.

methods.name: failure
methods.description: Sets the event or service status to failure.

methods.name: findList
methods.description: Returns a list of entities matching the specified fields.

methods.name: findOne
methods.description: Finds a single entity by primary key.

methods.name: findOne
methods.description: Finds a single entity by primary key, possibly using additional fields and arguments.

methods.name: makeValue
methods.description: Creates a new, empty entity value.

methods.name: makeValue
methods.description: Creates a new, empty entity value with specified fields.

methods.name: runService
methods.description: Runs a service synchronously and returns the result.

methods.name: runService
methods.description: Runs a service synchronously with additional arguments and returns the result.

methods.name: success
methods.description: Sets the event or service status to success.

methods.name: success
methods.description: Sets the event or service status to success with a message.
